subject: Important Update: Upcoming Meeting Schedule Change
body: Dear team members, I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to inform you about a change in the schedule of our upcoming team meeting. The meeting originally scheduled for Friday, June 25th, will now be moved to Monday, June 28th at 10:00 AM. Please mark your calendars accordingly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to me. Thank you for your attention. Best regards, [Your Name]
